title: #418 Kannada Trailer Out: The Last Warning
excerpt: Official trailer for #418 Kannada released by Mythri Movie Makers.
body:
• The trailer for #418 Kannada dropped October 05, 2026 via Mythri Movie Makers.
  • Watch the trailer below — embedded from the official Mythri Movie Makers channel.

The makers of #418 Kannada have released the official trailer, unveiled October 05, 2026 on the Mythri Movie Makers YouTube channel.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters — watch it below.
